pages.title: Back to Its Old Self
pages.text: Restore an aging home rather than replace every material; a cupboard and wax help preserve its next corner.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Keep bark from stripping. Mortar repairs cracks; wax preserves rustable iron and flint-and-steel removes moss. Learn material behavior instead of collecting every aged variant.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Apply mortar to cracked brickwork. Repair the cracked material.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Burn moss away with Flint and Steel. Prevent its regrowth on the treated surface according to the author.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Strip a log, save its bark, then apply matching bark to a stripped log. Recover the bark appearance; bark can also be used for fuel or compost.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Wax rustable iron with Honeycomb or Tallow; remove only early exposed rust in survival. Preserve a chosen stage; heavily rusted doors stay toggled instead of closing when unpowered.
